C.defining_statement: constraint strain is pressure produced by contradiction within the measured window

R.defining_statement: refusal density is the concentration of refusal relative to active constraint statements
R.formula_or_rule: count refusal markers relative to constraint statements

F.defining_statement: fixation is persistence of substantially the same constraint bearing pattern across successive states
F.formula_or_rule: semantic or structural persistence across consecutive constraint expressions

E.defining_statement: escalation is positive change in commitment or constraint intensity across sequence

D.defining_statement: deflection is movement away from the active constraint bearing subject or relation
D.formula_or_rule: one minus constraint relevant share or a declared comparison proxy

N.defining_statement: noise is activity that consumes representational space without proportionate constraint resolution
N.formula_or_rule: one minus resolution relative to constraint load with declared structural proxies

I.defining_statement: integration failure is failure of a correction or newly supplied constraint to alter subsequent behavior accordingly
I.formula_or_rule: one minus correction integration similarity or a declared proxy

O.defining_statement: O has conflicting maintained semantic names and therefore has no closed semantic origin yet
unresolved: marker canon says Overextension; compute.py says Overconfidence

L.defining_statement: L has conflicting maintained semantic names and therefore has no closed semantic origin yet
unresolved: marker canon says Load; compute.py says Coherence Loss

P.defining_statement: progress is newly integrated information or state change that advances resolution relative to the prior state
P.formula_or_rule: novelty plus entropy gain proxy in the maintained implementation

kappa.defining_statement: stored tension is unresolved dissonance carried forward as circuit state
kappa.formula_or_rule: persistent circuit state updated by energy step
